headline: STL @ MIL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is STL 3.72 at MIL 4.50, with a projected total of 8.22. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIL: STL moved -0.04 runs while MIL moved +0.79, changing the projected margin by -0.83 runs. The projected total climbed +0.75, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -10.7%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Jacob Misiorowski has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Alec Burleson, Jake Bauers, Iván Herrera, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Blake Perkins because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
